scope: Proposition 11.2 (Balanced high estimate) of the manuscript “The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$” (preprints/The-Quasi-Riemann-Hypothesis-September-30-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 003 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8fe93046f8cf5ef1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 83. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the supposition ∆1 > 0, for every primitive finite-order target η and all sufficiently large Z, |JI,η(Z) − fI,η(Z)| ≪η ZCI(β∗)−1/4800 . The displayed saving is independent of the target; the implied constant and lower threshold may depend on it.
